decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program is tightly aligned with the firm's established mental-health expertise and care infrastructure, so its continued operation should benefit from strong learning and refinement within the core business.

Senior-living counseling fits closely with the firm's eldercare services and facility network, making it a strategically complementary offer that the firm can improve and use to support its core care pathways.

The sheltered-workshop retail shop draws on the firm's inclusion and production capabilities, but because retailing remains more peripheral than direct care it stays more vulnerable if management reallocates resources.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the firm's eldercare activities and can build on existing knowledge of clients' daily-support needs, though its lower prominence and more operational service model make it less secure than core care offers.
